name: xfade-easing
holds: Easing curves and ported GL transitions for ffmpeg's xfade filter, as custom expressions.
notes: The custom expressions run on stock ffmpeg, without CSS easings, reverse or textures. The full set needs a patched ffmpeg, which Altocue never requires. A few ports come from Shadertoy and a forum post with no stated licence, so take only ports of MIT or BSD gl-transitions.
